title: Stay Calm During Layoff Anxiety
channelDescription: Ancient logic for the high-performance digital age

scenes.narrationSegment: The fear of losing your job can paralyze your best work. Stop trying to control the outcome of layoffs and start controlling your response. Uncertainty breeds anxiety, but you can choose to meet it with clarity instead of panic.
Marcus Aurelius taught that external events are beyond our command, but our judgments and actions remain ours. This is the dichotomy of control.
When you worry about a layoff, you are fighting a battle you cannot win. Redirect that energy toward what you can actually influence: your preparation and your composure.
Turn this philosophy into a daily routine. Update your resume and reach out to your network as concrete acts of agency.

In stressful meetings, practice the pause-before-response technique to maintain professional judgment. Treat every task as an opportunity to demonstrate resilience and keep your mind sharp regardless of external noise.
